title: Liqui Moly Motorbike Chain Cleaner 1602 (500ML)
detail_text: DESCRIPTION Specially developed cleaner with selected solvent combinations for fast, easy cleaning and degreasing structural parts in the two-wheel sector. PACKAGING SIZE 500 Millilitres (ML) AREAS OF APPLICATION For cleaning chains with and without O/X-rings on two-wheeled vehicles and quads. APPLICATION Place a box or rag under the parts to be cleaned. Spray dirty chains withMotorbike Chain Cleaner and let it run off. After the solvents have evaporated, the chain will be clean and free of grease and ready to be coated with Motorbike Chain Lube or Chain Spray White. (Note: Do not spray onto plastics. Do not lay rubber components in a container with Cleaning Fluid to clean them as they may be attacked. Note Check parts which have been painted for compatibility by testing on a hidden area.)
